title: A protocol for high-throughput screening, analysis and validation of protein glycopatterns
protocol: Wash untreated slides twice with 100% ethanol for 10 min each.
Dry the slides by centrifuging at 1000 rpm for 1 min.
Etch the slides by immersion in 10% NaOH overnight.
Sonify the etched slides for 15 min in 10% NaOH.
Rinse the slides four times with water for 2 min each.
Wash the slides twice with ethanol for 2 min each.
Dry the slides by centrifuging at 1000 rpm for 1 min.
Incubate 20 slides in a solution of 10 mL GPTS, 286 μL acetic acid, and 189 mL ethanol for 3 h, gently shaking.
Sonify the slides for 15 min in the same solution.
Wash the slides three times with ethanol for 10 min each.
Dry the slides by centrifuging at 1000 rpm for 10 min immediately after washing.
Bake the slides at 37°C for 3 h and store them at 4°C in a desiccator to be ready for subsequent modified surfaces.
Rinse the mouth with physiological saline immediately before saliva collection.
Collect whole saliva (approximately 1 mL) and place it on ice.
Add Protease Cocktail Inhibitor (1 μL/mL of whole saliva) to saliva immediately after collection.
Centrifuge whole saliva at 12,000 rpm at 4 °C for 10 minutes.
Collect the supernatant and filter it with a 0.22 μm pore size filter.
Store the filtered supernatant immediately or at -80 °C.
Dissolve Cy3 fluorescence dye in DMSO for 0.5 hours at room temperature according to the operating instruction manual.
Label extracted protein (a mixture of equal parts of protein and 0.1M Na2CO3, pH9.3) with Cy3 fluorescence dye.
Purify labeled proteins using Sephadex G-25 columns according to the manufacturer's instructions.
Dissolve lectins to a concentration of 1 mg/mL in the recommended buffer containing 1 mmol/L appropriate monosaccharide.
Spot each lectin in triplicate per block, with three blocks on one slide.
Incubate spotted slides in a humidity-controlled incubator at 50% humidity overnight.
Dry slides in a vacuum dryer for 3 hours at 37 °C to allow lectin immobilization.
Remove unbound lectins from their surface by washing twice with PBST for 5 min.
Rinse in PBS for 5 min.
Spin to dry.
Block slides with blocking buffer in the chamber at 25 ºC for 1 h in a rotisserie oven set at 4 rpm.
Wash slides twice with PBST for 5 min, followed by PBS for 5 min.
Spin to dry.
Dilute appropriate amount of Cy3-labeled protein in 0.5 mL of incubation buffer.
Incubate the mixture in the chamber at 25 ºC for 3 h in a rotisserie oven set at 4 rpm.
Wash slides twice with PBST for 5 min, followed by PBS for 5 min.
Spin to dry.
Scan microarrays with a 70% photomultiplier tube and 100% laser power settings using a Genepix 4000B confocal scanner.
Analyze acquired images at 532 nm for Cy3 detection by Genepix 3.0 software.
Subtract average background from the data points.
Remove values less than average background±2 standard deviations (SD) from each data point.
Normalize the median of the effective data points of each lectin to the sum of medians of all effective data points for each lectin in one block.
Observe each sample consistently by three repeated slides.
Average and calculate the SD of the normalized medians of each lectin from 9 repeated blocks.
Fix the gel slab with 100 mL fixation fluid overnight (at least 2 hours) with gentle shaking at room temperature.
Incubate the gel in 100 mL sensitization fluid with gentle shaking for 30 minutes at room temperature.
Rinse the gel six times with 100 mL washing fluid for 10 minutes each.
Incubate the gel in 100 mL staining solution with gentle shaking for 30 minutes at room temperature.
Rinse the gel twice with 100 mL washing fluid for 1 minute each.
Develop in developer under gentle shaking for several minutes at room temperature.
Store silver-stained gels in stop buffer.
Analyze Glycoproteins from step 30 by SDS-PAGE.
Transfer proteins in the gels to a PVDF membrane with a wet transfer unit for 1.5 h at 100 V.
Wash membranes twice with TBST.
Block membranes for 1 h with Carbo-Free Blocking Solution at room temperature.
Incubate membranes with Cy5-labeled lectins (2 µg/mL in Carbo-Free Blocking Solution) with gentle shaking overnight at 4°C in the dark.
Wash membranes twice each for 10 min with TBST.
Scan membranes on the red fluorescence channel (635 nm excitation/650 nm LP emission) with a voltage of 800 PMT using a phosphorimager.
